item.title: Best Temperate Forest Seeds in RimWorld (1.6 & Odyssey)
item.description: The best temperate forest seeds give beginners a balanced start: mild seasons, reliable farming, plenty of wood and a defensible layout. Use these with the current 1.6 / Odyssey version.
